name: Hibari 13
source:
"I'm cool as a mint, and that's why they call me Skylark 13."

[spoiler]As a member of the Mountain Dogs' Skylark unit, Skylark 13 has been involved in kidnapping patients of Hinamizawa Syndrome. He has also received combat training.[/spoiler]
